tools.name: get_guides
tools.title: Retrieve Borumi workflow guides
tools.description: `get_guides` retrieves required Borumi workflow instructions, guides, documentation, and exact segment input schemas. Call this first in each MCP connection.

guide_ids.description: Guide IDs to retrieve. Omit or pass an empty array to retrieve the basics guide.

tools.name: list_recent_projects
tools.title: List recent projects
tools.description: List the projects most recently modified in Borumi.

id.description: Connector-stable short alias for the Borumi project ID.

last_modified_at.description: Project modification time as an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp.

tools.name: list_open_projects
tools.title: List open projects
tools.description: List the projects open in Borumi and identify the active project.

active_project_id.description: Short project alias, or null when no project is active.

id.description: Connector-stable short alias for the Borumi project ID.

tools.name: get_ui_state
tools.title: Get UI state
tools.description: Get Borumi's active screen, Project, Project tool, Edit playhead, and relevant UI selection.

tools.name: focus_project
tools.title: Focus project
tools.description: Show an open Borumi Project in the app.

tools.name: set_active_project_tool
tools.title: Set active Project tool
tools.description: Show Script, Record, or Edit for the active Project. This does not control recording.

tools.name: create_project
tools.title: Create project
tools.description: Create an empty Borumi project and open it.

id.description: Connector-stable short alias for the Borumi project ID.

tools.name: open_project
tools.title: Open project
tools.description: Open a Borumi project by project ID or path.

id.description: Connector-stable short alias for the Borumi project ID.

tools.name: duplicate_project
tools.title: Duplicate project
tools.description: Duplicate a Borumi project by project ID or path, optionally assigning a name.

name.description: Name for the duplicate. When omitted, Borumi generates a copy name.
Name for the duplicate. When omitted, Borumi generates a copy name.

id.description: Connector-stable short alias for the Borumi project ID.

tools.name: rename_project
tools.title: Rename project
tools.description: Rename a Borumi project by project ID or path.

id.description: Connector-stable short alias for the Borumi project ID.

tools.name: get_project_overview
tools.title: Get project overview
tools.description: Get selected overview information for an open Borumi Project.

tools.name: get_scenes
tools.title: Get scenes
tools.description: Get ordered Scene metadata and Scripts from a Project or edit transaction.

tools.name: get_timeline
tools.title: Get timeline
tools.description: Get selected timeline layers for a Project-time range.

anyOf.description: Current Screen Highlight region and transition.

border_radius_ratio.description: Corner radius normalized to the shorter screen-source dimension.

height_ratio.description: Height of the clear region, normalized to the active screen source.

transition.description: Transition used at the Segment boundaries and from an immediately adjacent Highlight.

oneOf.description: Use Borumi's recommended smooth Highlight transition behavior.
Show, hide, or move the Highlight immediately without fading or smoothing.
Fade isolated Highlights and smoothly animate between adjacent Highlights.

width_ratio.description: Width of the clear region, normalized to the active screen source.

x_ratio.description: Left edge of the clear region, normalized to the active screen source.

y_ratio.description: Top edge of the clear region, normalized to the active screen source.

anyOf.description:
Serialized without a tag to keep the public `properties` object flat. Timeline responses
deserialize it through the segment's sibling `type` field because these shapes are ambiguous.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.title: Get transcript
tools.description: Get transcript content for a Project-time range.

tools.name: get_media_transcript
tools.title: Get media transcript
tools.description: Get source transcript content for a Media-time range.

tools.name: request_transcriptions
tools.title: Request transcriptions
tools.description: Request background transcription for audio Media in an open Project. Omit media_ids to request every timeline-used audio Media without a successful transcript. Existing successful transcripts are not replaced.

media_ids.description: Media IDs to transcribe. Omit to request every timeline-used audio Media without a successful Transcript.

tools.name: detect_speech
tools.title: Detect speech
tools.description: Detect speech or silence in selected microphone and system sound Clips for a Project-time range.

tools.name: inspect_timeline
tools.title: Inspect timeline
tools.description: Inspect composed or source visuals from a Project-time range. Use a low-quality contact_sheet for the first broad inspection; use frames for precise, high-quality, or individually saved images.

tools.name: get_export_status
tools.title: Get export status
tools.description: Get the latest status and resolved output details for an export job.

tools.name: cancel_export
tools.title: Cancel export
tools.description: Cancel an export that has not completed.

tools.name: get_media_import_status
tools.title: Get media import status
tools.description: Get the current status of a media import.

tools.name: cancel_media_import
tools.title: Cancel media import
tools.description: Cancel a queued or running media import.

tools.name: get_copy_status
tools.title: Get copy status
tools.description: Get the current status of a Scene or Segment copy operation.

tools.name: export_video
tools.title: Export video
tools.description: Start a video export from committed Project state.

tools.name: export_audio
tools.title: Export audio
tools.description: Start a mixed-audio export from committed Project state.

tools.name: export_transcript
tools.title: Export transcript
tools.description: Export the complete Project transcript as TXT, Markdown, or SRT.

tools.name: begin_project_edit
tools.title: Begin project edit
tools.description: Begin an isolated edit transaction for an open Borumi Project.

tools.name: import_media
tools.title: Import media
tools.description: Import one local media file into a Project edit transaction.

tools.name: create_scenes
tools.title: Create scenes
tools.description: Create ordered Scenes in an isolated Project edit transaction.

tools.name: update_scenes
tools.title: Update scenes
tools.description: Update Scene names or Scripts in an isolated Project edit transaction.

tools.name: move_scenes
tools.title: Move scenes
tools.description: Move Scenes within an isolated Project edit transaction.

tools.name: delete_scenes
tools.title: Delete scenes
tools.description: Delete Scenes from an isolated Project edit transaction.

tools.name: copy_scenes
tools.title: Copy scenes
tools.description: Copy complete Scenes from an open source Project into an isolated Project edit transaction, including connected Takes, Clips, Media, and Media support files.

tools.name: add_segments
tools.title: Add segments
tools.description: Add Takes, Media, overlays, and control segments to an isolated Project edit transaction. Before calling, retrieve the editing_segment_<type>_add guide for each segment type.

tools.name: trim_timeline
tools.title: Trim timeline
tools.description: Remove Project-time ranges from all or selected timeline content in an isolated Project edit transaction. Target exact layers when independent edit sets overlap.

target.description: Content to trim. Omit only when all affected content shares one edit set.

tools.name: untrim_segments
tools.title: Untrim segments
tools.description: Restore time at selected segment edges in an isolated Project edit transaction.

tools.name: split_segments
tools.title: Split segments
tools.description: Split timeline Segments and linked members at one or more Project times in an isolated Project edit transaction.

tools.name: delete_segments
tools.title: Delete segments
tools.description: Delete timeline Segments and, by default, their linked edit-group members from an isolated Project edit transaction.

expand_groups.description: Whether to expand each selected Segment to every member of its edit group. Defaults to true. Set to false only when the user explicitly intends to delete individual group members.

tools.name: move_timeline_segments
tools.title: Move timeline segments
tools.description: Move selected timeline segments by absolute placement or relative ripple insertion in an isolated Project edit transaction.

tools.name: update_segments
tools.title: Update segments
tools.description: Update properties of exact persisted timeline segments in an isolated Project edit transaction. Before calling, retrieve the editing_segment_<type>_update guide for each segment type.

tools.name: copy_segments
tools.title: Copy segments
tools.description: Copy timeline Segments from an open source Project into an isolated Project edit transaction. Edit-group members are included by default, and required Takes, Clips, Media, and Media support files are transferred automatically.

expand_groups.description: Whether to expand each selected Segment to every member of its edit group. Defaults to true.

tools.name: update_canvas
tools.title: Update canvas
tools.description: Update Project Canvas format or background in an isolated Project edit transaction.

tools.name: correct_media_transcript
tools.title: Correct media transcript
tools.description: Correct source transcript text in an isolated Project edit transaction.

tools.name: commit_project_edit
tools.title: Commit project edit
tools.description: Merge an isolated edit transaction into the latest open Project. Requires a short summary of the staged changes for user approval.

change_summary.description: Short user-facing sentence summarizing the complete staged Project changes. MCP clients may show it when requesting approval.

tools.name: abort_project_edit
tools.title: Abort project edit
tools.description: Discard an isolated Project edit transaction without changing the Project.
